traits.name: Damage Resistances
traits.description: Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons.

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.description: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. In addition, the elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. (Descriptive only: the 1d10 contact fire has no passive on-hit-by construct, as Black Pudding Corrosive Form. Entering a hostile creature's space is not modelled. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The elemental sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. (Descriptive only: not emits_light on this partial. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.description: For every 5 feet the elemental moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage. (Descriptive only: no water-movement or splash damage. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.description: The elemental makes two touch attacks.

actions.name: Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. (Descriptive only: the ongoing 1d10 until doused is not an on_hit rider. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)
